method.filtering_summary: Live search at 7:31 AM EAT on 11 sources pulled 2,264 postings (LinkedIn was rate-limited on the first try and answered on a retry at about 7:40). 1,760 were older than 7 days, 164 senior or excluded titles, 221 not target roles, 63 excluded Kenya, 2 already applied and 19 duplicates. Of the 35 that passed, 28 had already been shown in earlier briefings or reviewed. The 7 new ones were all dropped after a check on the posting: a co-founder role, a senior PhD-level ML contract, two US-only or non-software roles, a tender, a mid-senior IT ops role and a QA-only role. A web search for junior remote roles open to Africa found one that fits the window (FreshTalent, a stretch); the others were closed, outside Kenya, or older than 7 days. Nothing old was carried over.

stories.title: Nvidia ships open Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Bolt models for agents
stories.summary: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is a 120-billion-parameter open-weight model for enterprise agents, and two lightweight Bolt models run locally on RTX Spark AI PCs and DGX Spark workstations; Nvidia names Ramp, EY, Perplexity and Salesforce as users.
stories.why: Free, open models he can run or fine-tune for agent and automation work instead of paying per token.

stories.title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash cuts agent costs by 70%
stories.summary: MiniMax says M3.1 Flash makes inference nearly three times faster and agent-task usage 70% cheaper than its predecessor, at $0.15 input and $0.60 output per 1M tokens; it's on the MiniMax API now, with weights to follow later.
stories.why: A very cheap model for the high-volume agent pipelines he builds.

stories.title: Tenstorrent raises $1.5 billion at a $6.2 billion valuation
stories.summary: The inference-chip startup led by Jim Keller raised $1.5 billion, more than doubling its $2.6 billion late-2024 valuation, in a round led by Trace Capital and Innovation X.
stories.why: The week's biggest AI funding round, and a sign that money for AI infrastructure is still flowing.

stories.title: AI assistant startup Town becomes a unicorn four months after launch
stories.summary: Town, founded by former Plaid CTO Jean-Denis Greze, raised a $108 million Series B co-led by Forerunner and Menlo Ventures, taking total funding to at least $160 million.
stories.why: Workplace AI assistants that plug into email and other tools are the kind of integration work he does.

stories.title: Onafriq tried to sell its Nigerian agent-banking arm Baxi before shutting it
stories.summary: Onafriq announced Baxi's closure on October 16, citing inflation, naira depreciation and the shift to account-to-account transfers; its agency revenue fell 56% to $13.4 million in 2024.
stories.why: Shows how fast African fintech business lines change as payments move to direct transfers.

stories.title: Five35 Ventures makes 3.5x on its Complete Farmer exit
stories.summary: The gender-focused VC sold its whole stake in Ghanaian agritech Complete Farmer in March 2026 for 3.5 times its money, a 38% IRR, as the company's valuation rose from $6 million to $49 million.
stories.why: Rare African venture exits help keep funding flowing to startups that hire engineers.

stories.title: Microsoft's Nairobi engineering centre closure cuts more than 400 jobs
stories.summary: TechCabal reports Microsoft has shut its Africa Development Centre in Nairobi, leaving more than 400 engineers without jobs, after closing its Lagos hub in May 2024; about five staff will remain in the affected operation.
stories.why: Hundreds of experienced Nairobi engineers are now on the local job market, which raises competition for the roles he's applying to.

stories.title: Anthropic study: 80% of Claude session time is agents waiting on humans
stories.summary: Anthropic's study of its own staff found 80% of elapsed time in Claude sessions was agents waiting on human input, and the median employee spends 20% more time in meetings.
stories.why: Managing several AI agents at once is becoming the job, and that's a skill he can show.

stories.title: monday.com nudges middle managers out in its AI reorganisation
stories.summary: After laying off 350 people (20% of staff) this summer, monday.com is steering managers to resign; five senior executives, including two R&D VPs, are leaving or about to leave.
stories.why: AI is flattening software teams, so hands-on builders are in a better spot than managers.

stories.title: Safaricom launches M-PESA Jumbe to hide customer details on payment alerts
stories.summary: Jumbe replaces a customer's name and number with a JumbeID such as NK_74, and lets Lipa na M-PESA and Pochi la Biashara merchants add up to 50 staff to receive payment notifications.
stories.why: A new M-PESA notification flow that wallet and merchant apps like his X Money project may need to handle.

stories.title: Pesapal and Drift Consult take the RACK platform to retail shops
stories.summary: Pesapal and Drift Consult partnered to drive adoption of RACK, which combines payments, sales and business management for retail and hospitality businesses; Drift Consult will help firms digitise their operations.
stories.why: Kenyan payments companies are bundling software with payments, which creates integration work.
